Here's a voice-AI myth worth killing: you don't need new phone numbers to put an AI agent on the phone.
If your business already owns numbers — a PBX, a SIP provider, a carrier contract — a SIP trunk hands those lines to your agent directly. No porting. No new contract. No weeks-long wait to hear a dial tone.
CallNode trunks to your existing infrastructure or provisions fresh US/CA numbers over API — your call.
Own the plumbing, don't rent it twice.
#VoiceAI #AIAgents
